manual.hypercrown.forging: A Crown Fragment requires four Netherite Blocks, a Nether Star, two Hearts of the Sea, a Totem of Undying, and an Enchanted Golden Apple. The exact pattern is shown below and in JEI.
manual.hypercrown.assembly: Arrange three Crown Fragments in the crown-shaped pattern below to craft the Unawakened Crown. JEI can show this recipe whenever you need a reminder.
manual.hypercrown.awakening: In the End, right-click the Dragon Egg while holding the Unawakened Crown. You must have defeated the Ender Dragon, Wither, and Elder Guardian. The ritual consumes the egg and, outside Creative, costs the configured XP levels and leaves you at one health and one hunger.
manual.hypercrown.controls: HYPERCROWN: Hold Alt and press V/H/G/J to swap that key's selected power. Press the key normally to use it. Swapped powers keep separate cooldowns.
manual.hypercrown.blink: BLINK (V): Teleport to the spot you are looking at, up to 20 blocks away. Blocked landing spots fail. Default cooldown: 5s.
manual.hypercrown.phase_dash: PHASE DASH (Alt+V): Teleport up to 8 blocks in your look direction; walls stop the dash and the landing space must be clear. Default cooldown: 18s.
manual.hypercrown.anchor: ANCHOR (H): Sneak+H saves your position and dimension without a cooldown. H recalls you there; the location must still be accessible. Recall cooldown: 30s.
manual.hypercrown.time_snare: TIME SNARE (Alt+H): Applies Slowness II for 4s to non-allied living targets within 8 blocks. No targets means no cooldown. Default cooldown: 30s.
manual.hypercrown.energy_beam: ENERGY BEAM (hold/release G): Charge for up to 2s, then release to fire through visible targets. Default range: 50 blocks; base damage: 60, multiplied by Power Scale. Default cooldown: 10s.
manual.hypercrown.thunder_beam: THUNDER DIAMOND BEAM: Hold a Thunder Diamond in one hand and the Hypercrown in the other, then use the gem's socket action. The gem is consumed. The Energy Beam becomes 50% wider and deals 50% more damage, but its cooldown is doubled (20s by default).
manual.hypercrown.chain_lightning: CHAIN LIGHTNING (Alt+G): Hits up to 4 visible non-allied targets; first target within 24 blocks, later targets within 8 blocks of the previous target. 12 base damage each, Power Scale applies, damage capped at 40. Default cooldown: 25s.
manual.hypercrown.weather: WEATHER CONTROL (J): Cycles the overworld through rain, thunder, then clear. Default cooldown: 60s.
manual.hypercrown.nova: CROWN NOVA (Alt+J): Deals 10 base damage and knocks non-allied living targets away within 7 blocks. Power Scale applies; damage capped at 30. Default cooldown: 35s.
manual.hypercrown.flight: FLIGHT: Grants creative-style flight while the active Hypercrown is worn.
manual.hypercrown.speed: SPEED: Adds +300% movement speed by default. The server Power Scale also affects this bonus.
manual.hypercrown.mastery: WEAPON MASTERY: Adds +500% attack damage by default; Power Scale applies.
manual.hypercrown.critical: CRITICAL MASTERY: Player melee attacks are treated as critical hits.
manual.hypercrown.knockback: KNOCKBACK IMMUNITY: Grants full resistance to normal and explosion knockback.
manual.hypercrown.reduction: DAMAGE REDUCTION: Reduces incoming damage by 90% by default; the server can tune this.
manual.hypercrown.elemental: ELEMENTAL IMMUNITY: Negates fire, explosion, and fall damage, and extinguishes fire.
manual.hypercrown.status: STATUS IMMUNITY: Prevents harmful effects and periodically removes harmful effects already applied.
manual.hypercrown.survival: ETERNAL VIGOR: Restores 2 health per second, fills food and saturation, restores air, and grants Night Vision.
manual.hypercrown.mining: INSTANT MINING: Greatly increases block-breaking speed and harvest capability; bedrock remains unbreakable.
manual.hypercrown.smelt: AUTO-SMELT: Smelts ore and raw-material drops when you break blocks, if a smelting recipe exists.
manual.hypercrown.reflection: DAMAGE REFLECTION: Returns 50% of raw incoming damage to a living attacker by default.
manual.hypercrown.instant_kill: INSTANT KILL: 1% default chance to instantly defeat a non-boss, non-player mob with a direct melee hit.
manual.hypercrown.pacification: MOB PACIFICATION: Hostile mobs ignore you until you attack them.
manual.hypercrown.iframes: INVINCIBILITY: After damage, blocks further incoming hits for 40 ticks (2 seconds) by default.
manual.tactics.hyperstep: HYPERSTEP (C): A 1.05-strength burst in your look direction. No damage or fall protection. Cooldown: 12s.
manual.tactics.momentum: MOMENTUM: Successful damage builds up to 3 stacks, at most once every 2s. A stack decays each second after 5s without combat.
manual.tactics.hyperbreak: HYPERBREAK (B): Spend 3 Momentum to prime your next non-explosive hit for 5s. Adds up to 25%, capped at 3 extra damage. Cooldown: 30s.
manual.tactics.guard: CROWN GUARD (N): For 4s, absorbs a shared pool of up to 6 incoming damage. Repeated hits can exhaust it. Cooldown: 35s.
manual.tactics.awareness: TACTICAL AWARENESS (M): Reveals the approximate direction of the nearest visible, non-invisible player within 16 blocks. No target coordinates. Cooldown: 15s.
manual.tactics.gems: CROWN OF TACTICS GEMS: Socket gems while wearing the Crown of Tactics. Strider: +5% speed; Edge: +8% attack; Bulwark: up to 10% damage reduction; Gravity: +25% knockback resistance.

manual.hypercrown.catastrophe_gems: Find a gem by mining deepslate from Y -60 to -40: one chance in 10,000 per block. Time Quartz is one in 20,000. Fortune has no effect. Certain Bastion, Stronghold, End City, Nether Fortress, Ancient City, Ruined Portal, and Weaponsmith chests also contain gems. JEI lists each gem's locations.
manual.hypercrown.catastrophe_gem_crafti: Celestial Sapphire: orbital strike. Apocalyptic Ruby: nuclear blast. Void Emerald: giant slash. Thunder Diamond: railgun. Frost Topaz: absolute cold. Solar Opal: solar flare. Shadow Amethyst: void rift. Tectonic Jade: earthquake. Wind Sapphire: tornado. Time Quartz: time stop. Enhanced gems can only be made in the Celestial Focusing Table. Place two matching gems, four gold ingots, and one Nether Star anywhere in its 3x3 grid (1.5x power, 0.8x cooldown). All ten gems can be socketed: sneak-use one while holding the Hypercrown or a weapon with Gem Socket in your other hand.
manual.hypercrown.crown_forge: Wear the active Hypercrown and press K to open its forge. Combine one matching catastrophe gem, one Netherite weapon, and its catalyst in any input slots. Celestial Sapphire + Netherite Sword + Nether Star: Celestial Edge. Apocalyptic Ruby + Netherite Axe + TNT: Apocalypse Blade. Void Emerald + Netherite Sword + Eye of Ender: Void Reaper. Thunder Diamond + Netherite Sword + Lightning Rod: Thunder Fang. Frost Topaz + Netherite Sword + Blue Ice: Frostmaw. Solar Opal + Netherite Sword + Blaze Rod: Solar Brand. Shadow Amethyst + Netherite Axe + Echo Shard: Shadow Scythe. Tectonic Jade + Netherite Pickaxe + Obsidian: Tectonic Breaker. Wind Sapphire + Netherite Sword + Phantom Membrane: Gale Dancer. Time Quartz + Netherite Sword + Clock: Chrono Blade.
